Viridis is a contemporary residential development designed to provide a balanced lifestyle within the thriving DAMAC Hills 2 community. This well-maintained studio features bright living spaces, modern finishes, and a private balcony overlooking the swimming pool, making it an ideal option for investors seeking immediate rental returns or end-users looking for a comfortable home in a growing community.
